scope: Read-only ELF/ldd inspection of built SDK on this host; no clean-machine, older-distro, graphics or executable gameplay validation
portabilityConclusion: No missing shared libraries on the measured Ubuntu host. These host-built binaries are not universally portable; their declared minimum symbol versions and transitive library requirements must be met. OpenGL driver/context and audio/input hardware readiness are not proved by ldd.
abiCaveat: Direct executable and resolved host-library VERS_NEED inspection, not provided-symbol maxima. A minimum distro is not inferred from the version maxima alone; matching loader/libraries and graphics/audio/input platform support are also required.
